policy.rule: Source-confirmed behavior is not automatically an experiment outcome. Promote or revise claims only with evidence references.

claims.claim: The Studio pipeline is a deterministic UI simulation and does not invoke configured models or tools.
Studio Save is session-memory only and does not provide durable interruption recovery.
Only REQUIRE_APPROVAL pauses auto-run; BLOCK, REVISE, and failed stage results do not halt the simulation.
Generic Studio evidence strength is derived from objective word count rather than evidence content.
Python case verification is a deterministic structural gate followed by a closed-world exact-normalized accuracy gate.
The Python dataset runner has no per-case checkpoint or recovery and can stop after partial console output on a later validation error.
